name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  JUNE  24, 2025

CALL  TO ORDER  Maria  Davila,  Mayor  called  a Special  City  Council  Meeting  to order at
  5:00 p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Vice  Mayor  Joshua Barron,  Council  Member  Maria
  del Pilar Avalos,  Council  Member  Gil Hurtado  and Council  Member  Al
  Rios;  City  Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City
  Attorney  Raul F. Salinas

l

CERTIFICATES  The City  Council  issued  Certificates  of Recognition  to Legacy  High
  School  JV and Varsity  Softball  Teams.

2

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued  a Proclamation  declaring  June as LGBTQ+  Pride
  Month.

3

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued  a Proclamation  declaring  June as National  Post-
  Traumatic  Stress Disorder  Awareness  Month.

4

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued  a Proclamation  declaring  the 4th of July as
  Independence  Day.

5
PERSONNEL  RECRUITMENT

st SELECTION  The City  Council  received  and filed  the list of new and promoted  full-time
  employees  hired  or promoted  during  May  2025.

CLOSED  SESSION  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 5:46 p.m. and
  reconvened  at 7:07 p.m. with  all Members  of Council  present.  City
  Attorney  Salinas  reported  the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LEGAL  COUNSEL  - PENDING
  LITIGATION
  Pursuant  to Goverent  Code Section  54956.9(a),
  54954.9(b)(3)(C)

  a. Arlene  Gonzalez,  et al. v. City  of South  Gate, et al.
  b. Luis  Mondeagon  v. City  of South  Gate, et al.
  c. Gerardo  Nolasco  Jr. v. City  of South  Gate, et al.
   SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF JUNE  24, 2025

  Item 1(a) is a claim made against the city involving an alleged injury in a
  dancing class. The city was dismissed from that case by the plaintiff.
  There was no payment made by the city in connection  with that particular
  case and the city is no longer  a party  in that action.

  Item  1(b) is a claim  against  the city for an accident  in which  a city  of

  South  Gate employee  was involved  in a rear-end  collision  and the claim  is

  being  the city and the employee.
  made against  On a motion made by
  Councilwoman  Avalos and seconded by Vice Mayor Barron, there was a
  decision to authorize the City Attorney's  Office to defend that matter. The
  vote was 5-0.

  Item 1(c) is a claim  against  the city arising  from  a pothole  on the 710 on-

  ramp.  That on-ramp  is not part of the City  of South  Gate and on a motion
  made by Councilwoman  Avalos and seconded  by Vice Mayor  Barron  and

  on a vote of 5-0, the City of South Gate authorized  the defense  of that

  lawsuit.

  2.  CONFERF,NCE  WITH  LABOR  NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant  to Government  Code Section  54957.6

  Agency  Representation:  Rob Houston,  City  Manager

  Unrepresented  Employees:  Top Management/Department
  Directors,Hourly Employees

  Employee  Organizations:  SGMEA,  SGPMMA,  SGDMA,
  SGPMA,  SGPOA

  On item 2, there were discussions  and a brief  presentation  made by the

  City Manager concerning  ongoing  labor negotiations  involving  five  of the

  city unions.  And upon  completion  of that presentation,  guidance  was

  given,  but there was no reportable  action  taken.

ADJOURNMENT  Council  Member  Rios unanimously  adjourned  the meeting  at 7:13 p.m.
  and seconded  by Mayor  Davila.

PASSED  and APPROVED  on this 22nd day of July 2025.

  ATTEST:

Maria  Davila,  Mayor  Yodit  aze, City  Clerk
  l  J
